comment: Video model registry. Muapi documents the submit/poll protocol but NOT a per-model price list or a complete parameter list. Entries below are limited to what the official docs show and are 'unverified': live generation stays blocked until the operator confirms the endpoint in the MuAPI playground (Settings) or a real job completes. Confirm the endpoint and parameters for any model on the Muapi playground before the first live run, and enter your own per-clip price estimate in Settings (prices are never invented here).

models.label: Kling v2.1 Master · image-to-video
models.notes: Endpoint from the official muapi-cli registry (I2V_MODELS['kling-master'] = kling-v2.1-master-i2v). The earlier value 'kling-master' was copied from a text-to-video docs example and is not the image-to-video endpoint. Durations 5/10 s and 9:16 come from the Kling guide. Still unverified until you confirm it in the MuAPI playground or a real job completes. The docs do not list a price.
